::: {#rem-grid-or-vector}

#### One image, two arrangements

The file stores each image as a row of 64 numbers,
a [feature vector](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature-vector) in $\reals^{64}$,
the form that models such as logistic regression take as input.
@fig-digits-grid draws the same 64 numbers as an 8 by 8 grid:
with rows and columns counted from 0,
the pixel in row $i$ and column $j$ is entry $8i + j$ of the vector.
`pixels.reshape(-1, 8, 8)` turns the rows of the file into grids,
and nothing about the numbers changes.
Models that look at pixels' neighbours,
such as convolutional networks,
keep the grid.

:::
